"// 256-weight stride along the (Kt × Nt) flattened tile.\n"

"// Read a single byte from a Q4K-byte buffer at logical block-and-byte offset.\n"
"fn q4k_byte_at(buf_ptr: [*]u8, block_idx: i16, byte_idx: i16) u8 {\n"
"    const off: u32 = @as(u32, block_idx) * @as(u32, QK_K_BLOCK_BYTES) + @as(u32, byte_idx);\n"
"// Decode the 6-bit scale and min for sub-block `sub` (0..7) of a Q4K\n"
"// super-block read from `buf_ptr`. Mirrors Doppler's WGSL\n"
"// Returns sc and mn packed into a u16 (sc in low byte, mn in high\n"
"// byte) — CSL rejects array return types at runtime.\n"
"fn q4k_scale_min_bits(buf_ptr: [*]u8, block_idx: i16, sub: i16) u16 {\n"
"        const mid:  u8  = q4k_byte_at(buf_ptr, block_idx, 12 + base);\n"
"        const lo_b: u8  = q4k_byte_at(buf_ptr, block_idx, 4  + base);\n"
"        const hi_b: u8  = q4k_byte_at(buf_ptr, block_idx, 8  + base);\n"
"// Materialize the f32 B tile from the Q4K-byte tile staged by the\n"
"// broadcast. Per-block decode walks 4 chunks of 32 bytes each.\n"
"// For each byte at chunk*32+index, the LOW nibble lands at output\n"
"// position chunk*64+index (sub-block 2*chunk) and the HIGH nibble\n"
"// lands at chunk*64+32+index (sub-block 2*chunk+1). The two halves\n"
"// of one byte therefore use DIFFERENT scale/min — scales[2*chunk]\n"
"// for the lo half, scales[2*chunk+1] for the hi half. This matches\n"
"// byte and the canonical llama.cpp Q4_K_M dequant.\n"
"    const blocks_per_tile: i16 = Kt * Nt / QK_K;\n"
"            const sm_lo: u16 = q4k_scale_min_bits(buf_ptr, bi, lo_sub);\n"
"            const sm_hi: u16 = q4k_scale_min_bits(buf_ptr, bi, hi_sub);\n"
"                const packed_byte: u8 = q4k_byte_at(buf_ptr, bi, qs_byte_base + idx);\n"

"    // call, B_tile holds the same f32 weights the f32-path SUMMA\n"
